items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Reverend Kershaw and his wife and Professor Ball of the University of Cincinnati was down here for a band.

ctx.x: Yes. Would that be the Parisian Room?

The Parisian Room, yeah. Yeah, the Parisian Room. Well, we played there one Saturday night, and the Almerocka Club had warned us. So, after we got through playing there was this fellow, Eddie Kidd Wolf, former friend, a dry spider, and his partner was named Frank. He was an Italian. Well, when we got through playing at the Parisian Room, we went there and finished out the night, because we knocked off at 12 o'clock at the Parisian Room. And we went there and played a couple hours until 2 o'clock in the morning.…
